description: This file defines a controller class for handling password forgotten email logic within the OpenCart admin system. It manages the process of generating and queuing an email task to reset a user's password.

classes.name: Forgotten
classes.description: A controller class responsible for handling 'forgot password' email logic within the admin mail namespace.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to process the password reset request, generate email content, and enqueue an email sending task.
